question.prompt: If \(~\begin{array}{r|l}a&b \\ \hline c&d\end{array} = a\cdot d-b\cdot c,\) what is the value of \(~\begin{array}{r|l}3&4 \\ \hline 1&2\end{array}~?\)

solutions.explanation:
Match each entry with its position in the rule: \(a=3\), \(b=4\), \(c=1\), and \(d=2\). Therefore
\[
a\cdot d-b\cdot c
=3\cdot2-4\cdot1
=6-4=\boxed{2}.
\]
The answer is choice E.
solutions.title: Substitute into the given rule
